title: Passkey Name Prompt
description: Prevents a security page full of identical "Passkey" rows nobody can tell apart (or safely delete) by prefilling a distinct name right after creation, from the AAGUID for syncing managers like iCloud Keychain or 1Password and from the device for the rest ("Mac · Chrome", or a phone or security key when it was made off this device), numbering it when taken, blocking empty and duplicate names with a one-tap fix, nudging away from generic ones, and saying whether the passkey syncs or lives on this device only.
stops: Identical passkeys nobody can tell apart
mistakes: cant tell which passkey to delete
